condition: The College plans to replace its student records system during 2027 (SRC-0012), but the bid assumes integration with the current system's REST API (SRC-0027) must be functional by 2027-01-11.
event: The College implements a new records system mid-contract, causing the API integration to break and preventing identity or document verification.
effect: Disruption of enrollment signing processes and inability for the platform to verify student data, leading to a service outage.
assumptions: The current REST API will remain stable until the replacement occurs.
The College will provide sufficient lead time for integration rework.
trigger: The College announces the procurement or go-live timeline for the new student records system.
responses: Draft a change management clause requiring the College to provide technical API specifications for the new system at least 90 days prior to switchover.
Architect the integration layer as an abstraction to isolate the signing service from the specific records system API.
residual_exposure: Reliance on the College's communication regarding their infrastructure roadmap.

condition: The service must be live on 2027-01-11 (SRC-0032), but the migration of existing signed records is not required until 2027-02-28 (SRC-0026), a gap of 48 days.
event: Users access the new service during the spring enrollment period but find historical documents are not present, appearing as missing.
effect: High volume of support tickets regarding missing documentation, resulting in administrative overhead and a loss of user confidence in the platform.
assumptions: Students do not strictly require historical records for spring enrollment tasks.
The old system remains accessible for read-only lookups during this gap.
trigger: Helpdesk receives requests regarding missing records after 2027-01-11.
responses: Prioritize the migration of documents from the last 12 months for completion before 2027-01-11.
Display a message in the new UI directing users to the legacy system for records created prior to 2027-01-11.
residual_exposure: 48 days of degraded user experience regarding historical record retrieval.
